The stage of taking the javelin back behind the body

Holding the javelin

The javelin is held at the last end of its binding. In this way a better grip on the centre of gravity of the javelin is obtained. There are 3 methods of holding the javelin.

i. Pen-holding style grip

In this kind of grip the javelin is held like holding a pen, i.e. the index finger and the thumb are equal, and support is given to the javelin by the middle finger.

ii. V-shaped grip

In this method the javelin is held in the index finger and the middle finger, from which a V shape is formed, and support is given with the thumb.

iii. Fist-shaped grip

In this method the javelin is held in the fist. After gripping the javelin well, it is lifted to the height of the forehead above the shoulder and parallel to the ground. Its point is turned slightly inward, while the elbow …
